title: Final mixed run-through (30 marks, 25 minutes)
subject: Mathematics
source: Written for mathematics/y11 lesson 100 (Final mixed run-through (portal quiz written for this lesson; original questions with mark-scheme answers))
intro: Lesson 100. Own 4MA1-style questions, one from each area. Show working; give lengths to 3 significant figures.

questions.q: Write 0.363636... (recurring) as a fraction in its simplest form. [2]
Solve y = x + 1 and x² + y² = 25 simultaneously. [5]
Find the gradient of y = 3x² - 4x at x = 2. [2]
A histogram bar for 20 ≤ t < 30 has frequency density 4.5. Find its frequency. [1]
A sector of a circle of radius 6 cm has angle 50°. Find its arc length. [2]
p = 24.6 and q = 3.2, both to 1 d.p. Find the upper bound of p - q. [2]
A box has 7 green and 5 yellow beads. Two are taken without replacement. Find P(both the same colour). [3]
In triangle ABC, a = 10, b = 8 and A = 70°. Find angle B. [3]
